major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown: enter it with a pandemic-extended Agony so no global is wasted refreshing dots, then spend Unstable Affliction and channel Malefic Grasp for the whole window, emptying your shards before the last 8 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown with Agony, Corruption or Unstable Affliction ticking, drop to 2 or fewer Soul Shards first as Soul Harvester so the Succulent Souls do not overcap, and line it up immediately before Summon Darkglare.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hellcaller only: press it on cooldown and sync it with Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest, dumping Unstable Affliction inside the 20 second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 442726 is the castable 1 min cooldown row; 430014 is the talent node and 446285 the 100 yd variant. Not pressed in the sampled Soul Harvester parse.

rule.description: Agony stays up on every target
rule.action: Never let Agony drop: it is your only Soul Shard generator and it ramps from zero. Refresh inside the pandemic window at under 5.4 seconds remaining, 4.5 seconds with Creeping Death, and hold it on up to 5 targets in AoE.

rule.description: Cascading Calamity kept up by Unstable Affliction
rule.action: Cast Unstable Affliction on a target that already has it before the 15 second haste buff expires, and only dump the rest of your shards inside Summon Darkglare or Malevolence.

rule.description: Dark Harvest after dumping Soul Shards
rule.action: Spend down to 2 or fewer Soul Shards with Unstable Affliction before channeling Dark Harvest, otherwise the shards it generates are wasted. Then enter Summon Darkglare on the shards it just gave you.
Channel Dark Harvest first, then summon the Darkglare, so the 3 second channel does not eat globals inside the 20 second amplification window.

rule.description: Haunt and dots before Dark Harvest and Darkglare
rule.action: Pre-cast Haunt, apply Agony and your second dot, cast Unstable Affliction down to 2 Soul Shards, then Dark Harvest into Summon Darkglare with trinkets and racials.

rule.description: Seed of Corruption on stacked targets
rule.action: From 3 stacked targets, 2 as Soul Harvester, apply and maintain Corruption or Wither with Seed of Corruption instead of hard-casting it, and fire it at 5 Soul Shards or above 2 shards just before Dark Harvest comes up.
As Hellcaller, line Malevolence up with Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest rather than pressing it in isolation, and spend Unstable Affliction inside both windows.
